_doc: A brass spittoon (PropModels' spittoon, the kit's third kind, a loose rigid prop: LooseProp). Spun brass about a millimetre thick on a heavy rim, ~2 kg, with a third of a litre of spit and tobacco juice in its bowl. A ball goes through it (the brass costs a ball what ~3 mm of wood would, each side) and knocks it rolling; a boot sends it; a hard landing (4 m/s, a fall from a table's height onto boards) dents it; it never breaks or burns. Tipped over or holed low, it lets what's in it go. docs/briefs/prop-lab.md, src/props/loose_prop.gd.
